definitions.gloss: work of art; art object; artwork (esp. as an item)
definitions.explanation: An item recognized as a work of art — paintings, sculptures, ceramics, lacquerware, and the like. Treats the work as a physical object that can be owned, displayed, insured, or stolen.

examples.japanese: {貴重|きちょう}な{美術品|びじゅつひん}を{展示|てんじ}する。
examples.english: We exhibit valuable works of art.

examples.japanese: この{美術品|びじゅつひん}は{江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}のものだ。
examples.english: This artwork is from the Edo period.

examples.japanese: {個人|こじん}{所有|しょゆう}の{美術品|びじゅつひん}が{美術館|びじゅつかん}に{寄贈|きぞう}されることもある。
examples.english: Privately owned works of art are sometimes donated to museums.

notes:
Compound of {美術|びじゅつ} (fine art) + {品|ひん} (article, item). Emphasizes the work as a tangible object, distinguishing it from {美術|びじゅつ} (the activity/field of fine art).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {美術品|びじゅつひん}の{展示|てんじ}: art exhibition
- {美術品|びじゅつひん}を{収集|しゅうしゅう}する: to collect art
- {美術品|びじゅつひん}の{鑑定|かんてい}: art appraisal
- {高価|こうか}な{美術品|びじゅつひん}: expensive artwork

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {美術|びじゅつ}: fine art — the field or activity, not the individual object
- {芸術|げいじゅつ}{作品|さくひん}: work of art — broader, includes music, literature, and performance
- {骨董品|こっとうひん}: antique — older items valued for age as well as artistry
